attribution.limitation: This is a contribution-share approximation for separately backtested 1M sleeves, not a compounded portfolio accounting ledger.
attribution.sleeve_pnl: A trade pnl_amount multiplied by its holding-period average of weight_A(t) * total_exposure(t); B by (1-weight_A(t)) * total_exposure(t).
attribution.weights: monthly risk-parity and volatility-target records, carried forward until the next record.

candidate.portfolio: 60d inverse-vol risk parity A bounds [0.2,0.8], then 15% vol target [0.2,1.0], monthly

classification: preregistered concentration audit of the R312 passing candidate; no strategy or parameter changes
decision_rule: All C1-C7 pass -> candidate_for_paper_trading_review only; any failure -> keep research-only. Do not change weights, portfolio rule, window, or thresholds after seeing results.

gates.C2_top1: largest positive symbol net P&L share <= 25%
gates.C3_top3: top three positive symbol net P&L share <= 55%
gates.C4_top5: top five positive symbol net P&L share <= 75%
gates.C5_recent_breadth: at least 8 distinct recent-12m symbols with positive attributed P&L
gates.C7_loss: largest single-symbol loss <= 20% of gross profit

known_limitations: Industry classification is a current snapshot, not historical PIT.
Attribution uses holding-period average portfolio weights and separately run sleeve P&L.
R40 is a local research snapshot; canonical data drift remains unresolved.
A passing concentration audit would not authorize production while data provenance is unresolved.
